title: Variance and total stable influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function with positive variance. For every $\rho\in(0,1]$, its variance multiplied by $\rho^{I(f)/\operatorname{Var}(f)-1}$ is at most its total stable influence at parameter $\rho$, where $I(f)$ denotes its total influence.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
